$comment: Local extension: upstream SAP abap-file-formats has no search-help schema. Field names and value ranges are derived from the DDIC maintenance structures DD30V (header), DD31V (included search helps), DD32P (parameters) and DD33V (parameter mapping), verified on S/4HANA with DDIF_SHLP_GET / DDIF_SHLP_PUT.
title: Search Help Properties
description: ABAP DDIC search help (SE11 search help) properties

originalLanguage.title: Original Language
originalLanguage.description: Two-letter ISO language code of the original definition (DD30V-DDLANGUAGE)

name.title: Search Help Name
name.description: DDIC search help name (DD30V-SHLPNAME); at most 30 characters.

package.title: Package
package.description: Package recorded for the search help in TADIR (read-side only; create/push take the package from the command line).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: elementary = ISSIMPLE (selection method + field list); collective = ELEMEXI (includes other search helps + parameter mapping).

selectionMethod.title: Selection Method
selectionMethod.description: DD30V-SELMETHOD: table / view / maintenance view used by an elementary search help.

textTable.title: Text Table
textTable.description: DD30V-TEXTTAB: text table supplying the descriptive text of the selection method.

parameters.title: Interface Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters of the search help (DD32P), in interface order.

position.title: Position
position.description: DD32P-FLPOSITION, 1-based. Derived from the array order when omitted.

rollName.title: Data Element
rollName.description: DD32P-ROLLNAME. Derived from the selection method (elementary) or the mapped sub-search-help parameter (collective) when omitted.

input.title: Input
input.description: DD32P-SHLPINPUT: parameter can be used as a selection criterion.

output.title: Output
output.description: DD32P-SHLPOUTPUT: parameter is shown in the result list.

selectionPosition.title: Selection Position
selectionPosition.description: DD32P-SHLPSELPOS: position in the selection area (0 = hidden). Defaults to the parameter position when input is true.

listPosition.title: List Position
listPosition.description: DD32P-SHLPLISPOS: position in the result list (0 = hidden). Defaults to the parameter position when output is true.

includedSearchHelps.title: Included Search Helps
includedSearchHelps.description: Search helps included by a collective search help (DD31V).

position.title: Position
position.description: DD31V-SHPOSITION, 1-based. Derived from the array order when omitted.

viaSearchHelp.title: Via Search Help
viaSearchHelp.description: DD31V-VIASHLP: parent search help for nested includes (defaults to the collective search help itself).

hide.title: Hide
hide.description: DD31V-HIDEFLAG: hide the included search help in the selection list.

parameterMappings.title: Parameter Mappings
parameterMappings.description: Maps collective interface parameters to included-search-help fields (DD33V).

valueDirection.title: Value Direction
valueDirection.description: DD33V-VALUEDIREC: import (input / check, I or C) or export (E).
